shared_components.title: Shared state, utilities and I/O
shared_components.purpose: Stores routing state and provides precision kinds, time, namelists, forcing, map/restart/output handling, build support and shared numerical helpers.
shared_components.relationship: runtime and build dependencies shared by the proposed modules

modules.title: Local inertial river and floodplain routing
modules.expensive_path: CMF_CALC_OUTFLW and CMF_CALC_FLDSTG sweep catchments during adaptive substeps; downstream flux accumulation shares target cells. No hotspot profile was collected.
modules.rationale: Momentum update, storage-to-stage diagnosis and the storage update form the routing loop over shared state arrays.
excluded: Bifurcation pathway flow and the levee scheme, which are separate optional schemes with their own state and are their own module
Dam operation, which overrides the outflow of specific cells rather than changing the solver
hazards: Official global/regional scripts exist. The bundled Mozambique example ran in 4.331898 seconds with routing and bifurcation; this source submission omits its forcing/restart archive for unresolved redistribution rights.
OpenMP ATOMIC on the scatter-add makes runs bit-reproducible only when NoAtom_CMF is set; the reduction order otherwise varies with thread count
Floodplain activation is threshold-based, so a rounding difference at the threshold changes a branch, not just a value
SinglePrec_CMF changes the working precision of the whole prognostic state
modules.purpose: Momentum update, storage-to-stage diagnosis and the storage update form the routing loop over shared state arrays.
primary_inputs: Runoff forcing, channel/floodplain storage and previous flux
algorithm_stages: Accumulate network fluxes and update storage
unique_responsibilities: Owns the routing loop and the physics dispatcher
modules.differences: The routing driver calls optional controllers; the ownership cut does not imply an independent call graph.
not_responsible_for: Bifurcation pathway flow and the levee scheme, which are separate optional schemes with their own state and are their own module
Dam operation, which overrides the outflow of specific cells rather than changing the solver
modules.classification: agent-authored module card; CLI-computed size and approval status

modules.title: Bifurcation pathways and the levee scheme
modules.expensive_path: CMF_CALC_PTHOUT updates a pathway list and accumulates flow at shared destinations. The levee controller diagnoses protected and unprotected storage. No separate profile was collected.
modules.rationale: This proposed module groups optional bifurcation flow and levee-protected storage; the physics and implementations differ, so the curator should confirm the grouping.
excluded: The main channel and floodplain momentum update, which is the routing module
hazards: The Mozambique example exercises bifurcation but not levees. Official levee workflows require external maps, forcing and protection parameters; they were not run.
Pathway targets are read from a map file, so the connectivity is data, not code
modules.purpose: This proposed module groups optional bifurcation flow and levee-protected storage; the physics and implementations differ, so the curator should confirm the grouping.
unique_responsibilities: Non-tree pathway flow and levee storage corrections
modules.differences: Grouped optional schemes with different physics; the curator must confirm grouping. Mozambique exercises bifurcation, not levees.
not_responsible_for: The main channel and floodplain momentum update, which is the routing module
modules.classification: agent-authored module card; CLI-computed size and approval status

modules.title: River water temperature, heat budget and surface ice
modules.expensive_path: Water/ice advection and surface energy-budget calculations update thermal state. The unit tests establish functional execution, not a representative acceleration workload.
modules.rationale: Thermodynamics has its own water-temperature and ice state. Its 11 official test programs comprise ten ordinary tests and one expected-failure test; the coupled example needs atmospheric forcing.
excluded: The water routing that supplies the velocities, which is the routing module
Tracer transport of dissolved constituents (cmf_ctrl_tracer_mod), which is a separate optional scheme
hazards: The ten ordinary module tests pass and the cold-inflow program rejects its input with the intended diagnostic. The global coupled example needs GSWP3 fields, interpolation matrices, a map and runoff.
Requires the heatlink preprocessor switch, which is off in the stock adm/Mkinclude
The investigation uses binary64. The shared test_numeric_utils contains 1.0e200 and overflows in single precision; single-precision thermal tests were not measured.
The upstream cold-inflow test expects a specific kernel error; normal process completion would be a failure.
test_heatlink_config reads its namelist by a path relative to src/heatlink
modules.purpose: Thermodynamics has its own water-temperature and ice state. Its 11 official test programs comprise ten ordinary tests and one expected-failure test; the coupled example needs atmospheric forcing.
primary_inputs: Atmospheric energy fluxes and inflow temperature
algorithm_stages: Evaluate surface heat exchange and freeze/thaw
modules.differences: Self-contained kernel tests provide prescribed routing state; coupled simulations depend on routing and forcing. No full heatlink integration result is claimed.
not_responsible_for: The water routing that supplies the velocities, which is the routing module
Tracer transport of dissolved constituents (cmf_ctrl_tracer_mod), which is a separate optional scheme

modules.title: Dam and reservoir operation
modules.expensive_path: Per-reservoir rules override routing outflow using storage and inflow. The included map/src/src_dam tools estimate parameters before a simulation; no profile was collected.
modules.rationale: Reservoir rules form a separate control scheme. The proposed cut includes preprocessing; acceptance of that boundary is a curator decision.
excluded: The routing solver whose outflow it overrides
hazards: gosh/test6-reservoir_glb15min.sh and options_full.sh are official examples. They need unbundled global maps, runoff and dam parameters; neither was run.
Operation rules are branchy and threshold-driven, which is where a port loses equivalence first
map/src/src_dam is parameter-estimation preprocessing and may deserve its own cut rather than riding along here
modules.purpose: Reservoir rules form a separate control scheme. The proposed cut includes preprocessing; acceptance of that boundary is a curator decision.
primary_inputs: Dam locations, capacity and operating parameters
unique_responsibilities: Reservoir operating rules plus proposed dam preprocessing
modules.differences: Control and preprocessing module. map/src/src_dam ownership is explicit and requires curator acceptance; no hotspot profile.
not_responsible_for: The routing solver whose outflow it overrides

modules.title: Suspended sediment transport
entrypoints: src/MAIN_cmf built with the sediment scheme (etc/sediment/)
modules.expensive_path: Sediment flux, erosion and deposition update grain-class storage alongside water routing. No profile was collected.
modules.rationale: The optional sediment subsystem has its own state, control and restart/output routines.
excluded: River water temperature, the other add-on that rides the same sub-step
hazards: etc/sediment/run_sediment.sh is an official example. Its map, runoff and sediment parameter inputs are not present at their expected paths; it was not run.
The subsystem is newer than the core and less exercised upstream
modules.purpose: The optional sediment subsystem has its own state, control and restart/output routines.
unique_responsibilities: Sediment prognostic state and grain-class transport
modules.differences: Optional sediment physics owns its source subtree; its official example remains unmeasured.
not_responsible_for: River water temperature, the other add-on that rides the same sub-step

not_packaged.why: It exists to drive CaMa-Flood from an external Earth system coupler and cannot be exercised, or accelerated, without that coupler.

It is a thin advection scheme over the routing fluxes with no in-tree test and no distinct expensive path; it would be a THIN module. It is a candidate to fold into the routing module later if a check set emerges.

not_packaged.what: map/src/src_param and map/src/src_region, the map preprocessing tools
not_packaged.why: Map preprocessing lies outside the proposed runtime modules. Basic maps have published CC BY 4.0 terms; availability and permission for other resolution-specific inputs must be checked separately.

not_packaged.what: util/, etc/ and the post-processing and validation scripts
not_packaged.why: Analysis and plotting utilities, not simulation physics.
A boundary-condition scheme with no in-tree test and no separable expensive path.

known_review_gaps: The local historical author/coordinator approval exists; public curator approval of the five-module cut has not been established. Generated approval_status reflects the local record only.
The curator must accept the enumerated data-only omissions, or obtain upstream/provider permission for a full-tree import.
Native observations do not establish scientific equivalence, a representative acceleration workload, Linux portability or full-system coverage.
